app.disclaimer: Reads the game's own log file only. No memory access, no injection, no modified game files.
app.subtitle: Match recorder
app.title: Forts Ladder
draft.cancelled_sub: Nothing was recorded. Queue again when you are ready.
draft.finished_hint: These maps and commanders are binding — deviations show up in the log afterwards.
draft.headline: Draft
draft.hidden_later: The opponent's commander for later games stays hidden until the game before it has been played.
draft.hint_start: Pick a format and press “New draft”.
draft.leave_penalty_ask:
This is a match the queue paired you for, and it is not finished. Leaving now ends it for your opponent as well and closes the queue to you for a while — longer each time.

If the game crashed or the wrong commander loaded, agree a void with your opponent instead. That costs nothing.
draft.needs_login: Sign in first: open the server in a browser, log in with Discord, then connect the client under Live.
draft.needs_server: A draft against another player needs a server. Set the address under Live.
draft.share_code: Send them the code on the left.
draft.strike: {0} was removed neutrally by lot so both sides ban equally often.
draft.sub_ban_commander: Remove a commander for the whole series
draft.sub_ban_map: Remove a map from the pool
draft.sub_pick_commander: Choose blind — both are revealed together
draft.too_little:
Not enough material: {0} maps, {1} commanders.
Was Forts detected?
draft.you_locked: You locked in {0} — revealed when both have chosen
handoff.aborted_them: Series aborted: somebody in the other lobby did not draft it
handoff.aborted_you: Series aborted: somebody in your lobby did not draft it
handoff.decided_sub: Agree who hosts, create the custom lobby in Forts, and press "I am hosting".
handoff.in_lobby: You are in the series lobby
handoff.in_lobby_sub: Play {0}. Each finished game is reported automatically, and the next commanders open when it is.
handoff.lobby_is: Lobby {0} — recorded games in it count for this series.
handoff.no_host_id: The Steam account of the host is not known, so Steam cannot be pointed at the lobby.
handoff.settings_written: Lobby settings written, password {0}. Start Forts and host; the size and the locks are already set.
handoff.they_host_sub: Wait for the lobby, then Join. Do not open one yourself.
handoff.waiting_for_lobby: {0} has not opened the lobby yet
handoff.waiting_for_lobby_sub: Starting Forts now would only put you in the menu. Wait for the Join button.
handoff.watching_sub: Create the custom lobby in Forts — this picks it up from the game log by itself.
identity.did_you_mean: Not an exact match — did you mean:
identity.explain: The ranking only knows display names, the game only knows Steam IDs. This one answer connects them. It stays on your machine until you report a result.
identity.headline: Who owns this machine?
identity.name_taken: “{0}” is already linked to {1}. If that is your alt account, a league admin can record it.
identity.no_account: No Steam account detected yet. Start Forts once so the log file gets created.
identity.no_list: No ranking list available — the name is stored unchecked.
identity.persona_missing: (Steam name not found in the log)
identity.title: Who are you?
identity.unlisted: Not on the ranking. You can still save it if you're new.
live.empty: No matches are running right now.
live.headline: Live matches
live.no_room: No room — Forts allows nine clients, spectators included
live.nothing_published: Nothing is listed under Live to open or close.
live.offline:
Not connected to a ladder server.

Set the address under Server and start it with:
uvicorn server.app:app
live.published: The series is listed under Live — people can ask to watch.
live.sub: Running games — ask the host to let you spectate
live.terms_ask: Ask the host to let you in on these terms?
lobby.close_forts: Close Forts first. It reads these settings at startup and overwrites them on exit.
lobby.no_backup: No backup to restore. Nothing was ever changed.
lobby.no_file: multiplayer.lua not found. Host a lobby once in Forts and it will exist.
lobby.restored: Your own lobby settings are back.
lobby.unreadable: multiplayer.lua does not look like the file this expects; nothing was changed.
lobby.written: Written: {0} slots, sides and forts locked.
login.asking_discord: Asking Discord — confirm in the Discord window
login.no_server: No server configured. Enter its address under Live.
login.pair_explain: Log in on the server with Discord, then paste the code it shows you. This is only needed because the Discord app could not be asked directly.
login.server_has_no_app: This server has no Discord application configured, so nobody can sign in to it yet. That is the operator's side, not yours.
queue.headline: Matchmaking
queue.idle_sub: You will be paired with someone near your rating. The map veto and commander bans happen before the match starts.
queue.in_series_sub: Play it out and finish it — or agree a void — before looking for another match. Your opponent is waiting for you specifically.
queue.mode_unavailable: Team modes need whole sides paired, not two individuals — not built yet, so it cannot be queued.
queue.no_pools_yet: This server has no map pool yet. An admin has to publish one from a client that has Forts installed.
queue.not_signed_in: Not signed in — pressing Find match will sign you in.
queue.penalty_sub: Letting a match offer lapse pauses the queue for {0} more seconds. Whoever did accept is not penalised.
queue.pools_published: Published {0} maps and {1} commanders — the queue is usable now.
queue.rules: Only players who opted in can be paired, and only matches this ladder set up are rated. A match offer you ignore costs a short cooldown; declining does not.
queue.searching_sub: The accepted rating gap widens the longer you wait, so a quiet evening still finds you a game.
queue.steam_failed: Steam was not linked. The browser has to finish the sign-in.
queue.steam_waiting: Waiting for Steam in your browser…
queue.sub: Ranked 1v1 — paired by rating, drafted before you load in
replays.headline: Replays
series.clipboard_busy: The clipboard is busy. You can select the line in the field and copy it with Ctrl+C.
series.empty:
Nothing recorded yet.

Start Forts and play a match — the recorder follows along live. The game clears its log file on every start, so this window has to stay open while you play.
series.flag_needs_report: Send the series to the ladder first, then it can be reported.
series.flagged: Reported — an admin will look at this series.

series.lobby_changed: The lobby settings were changed during the series: {0}
series.report_not_two_sides: This series has no two clear sides, so it cannot be rated.
series.report_rated: Counted. The shared ranking now includes this series.
series.rescan_nothing: Nothing new. {0} game(s) known from the logs on this machine.
series.select: Select a series on the left.
settings.headline: Settings
settings.identity_sub: The name you are listed under on the community spreadsheet. A name matching your Discord login applies immediately; anything else waits for an admin to confirm it.
settings.name_none: Not set. Results cannot be reported under a name nobody has.
settings.name_pending: {0} — waiting for an admin to confirm it.
settings.not_signed_in: Not signed in. Nothing is sent anywhere until you are.
settings.server_sub: The default is the shared instance, so everyone is on the same ladder. Point it somewhere else to run your own.
settings.sub: Your account, the server this client talks to, and where Forts is.
settings.up_to_date: Version {0} is the newest there is.
